changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.11
changeSet.comment: nexus.chash_conformance_report(dim) reads each manifest row's collection's catalog row for its model (embedding_models.dimension) in place of the split_part model lists over the collection name; a manifest row whose collection has no catalog row is reported on its own line, 'nexus.catalog_document_chunks (no catalog row)', only when it has rows, by its own embedding_model column. Same signature, labels and dim guard. No data effect (RDR-229 P2.6).

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.11
changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks no longer refuses an origin by a quarantine- name prefix: the origin's catalog row must be lifecycle_state live (a test the body already made), so the row decides and the name is not read. Same signature and grants; the rest of the body is vectors-053-1. No data effect (RDR-229 P2.6).

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.11
changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_expire_client_quarantine drops the starts_with(p_quarantine_collection, 'quarantine-') arm of its scope guard: the sibling's and the origin's catalog rows (lifecycle_state, content_type) decide, so a quarantine row under any label is in scope and a prefixed label whose row says live is not. Same signature and grants; the rest of the body is vectors-056-2. No data effect (RDR-229 P2.6).
